reviews.text: Top dog training center!! The entire staff is amazing! I left my dog ​​there for a few days and she was taken care of fantastically!! Thank you all!
Excellent trainers, they know how to handle dogs amazingly well.
Great if you don't know where to leave your dog!

A happy oasis for our four-legged friends!
All the instructors are highly qualified and available!
I can only say thank you to Claudia B., Claudia R., Stefano, Marco, and the entire staff!!!
A positive experience, very professional and attentive. As luck would have it, it fell on a special birthday. Naturally, there was cake and plenty of excellent sparkling wine!
Professional and well-trained team, I got the results I wanted with my dogs (obedience, nosework, agility)

Indiana Kayowa is the place where the "grumpy" but brilliant Massimo Perla teaches owners how to love and care for their puppies so they can have a full, happy, and safe life. This innovative service (even though it's been running for over twenty years) is a place where dogs find everything they need. Lessons, of course (and I repeat, it's the owners who need to learn and be REprimanded, not the dogs), but above all everything else, from the dog pool in the summer to daycare to help them socialize with each other and let them roam free in company for the day, to boarding (the only one our little girl enjoys going to) and everything else. Of course, they also do sports, competitions, movies, and everything else, but the important thing is that you come to learn how to ensure even the least sociable dogs live well. Well done everyone.
Hospitality, professionalism, cleanliness, friendliness, highly recommended!!!
I have known the center for years, the staff is professional and helpful, top notch

What more can I say about this center, run by Massimo Perla (the pinnacle of dog training!)? Truly huge, with excellent instructors for all disciplines. The diving pool needs significant improvement, as it's incredibly small and poorly equipped for such a mega dog training center.
